description: Curated default tool list for the radiate MCP server. Hosts that support an allowlist (Hermes tools.default_enabled, OpenClaw profile allow lists, Claude Code permissions) should enable only these by default. Tools that a connection's Radiate catalog does not offer are simply absent; nothing here grants access.

opt_in.run_compute_job: Runs a job on a GPU connected through the Radiate compute connector. High risk: every call needs its own approval in Radiate. Enable it only for the radiate-local-compute skill.

skill_tools._note: Extra tools a skill uses beyond the default list. Enable them when you use that skill.
